title: Ploeg + De Vloer competitive research evidence
method: Primary official documentation, source repositories, product announcements and pricing pages inspected using web retrieval. Competitors were not deployed or independently benchmarked.
claims_policy: Documented and advertised behavior is distinguished from tested behavior. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence. Main branch documentation may lead stable releases.
pricing_currency: USD where a numeric vendor price is stated; no exchange-rate conversion performed.

sources.title: Kandev repository
sources.supports: AGPL-3.0 workbench; heterogeneous agents, workflows and remote executors.
sources.limitations: README operator roadmap must not be read as absence of the separately documented Kubernetes executor.

sources.title: Kandev feature status
sources.supports: Status distinctions for authentication, tenancy, Office and Kubernetes executor.
sources.limitations: Describes current main; released builds may lag. Team and tenancy limitations are version-specific.

sources.title: Kandev Kubernetes guide
sources.supports: Per-session Pod execution, workspace storage and resource identity/recovery.
sources.limitations: Documentation inspected; no cluster deployment performed.

sources.title: Kandev integrations
sources.supports: Specific integrations require configured credentials and provider capabilities.
sources.limitations: No exact ClickUp or Forgejo lifecycle qualification established.

sources.title: Kandev team access
sources.supports: Team-oriented access is documented within the authenticated product path.
sources.limitations: Use feature-status caveats when assessing isolation.

sources.title: OpenHands Agent Canvas repository
sources.supports: MIT Agent Canvas, multiple agent backends, ACP and separate SDK/automation repositories.
sources.limitations: Read current repository identity; old OpenHands application comparisons can be stale.

sources.title: OpenHands Enterprise versus Open Source
sources.supports: Canvas automation options differ from enterprise authentication, organizations and scalable sandbox features.
sources.limitations: A Docker-wrapped local stack is not equivalent to multi-tenant isolation.

sources.title: OpenHands Enterprise repository
sources.supports: Enterprise integrations, team controls and usage monitoring advertised.
sources.limitations: Commercial component boundary; no deployment or contract tested.

sources.title: OpenHands self-hosting guide

sources.limitations: Main branch documentation may differ from selected deployed version.

sources.title: OpenHands pricing

sources.title: Coder Agents

conflicts.resolution: Dedicated current guide and feature inventory document a Kubernetes executor. README operator roadmap does not negate that implementation.
Do not calculate Teams TCO. Obtain current checkout or written quote; public sources disagree on base-plus-seat versus minimum wording.
Treat older Mission Control content as historical inspiration; current acquisition and read-only repository notices govern recommendation.

research_gaps: No independently verified security or tenancy boundary
No paid customer interviews or measured willingness to pay
No validation of specific ClickUp/Forgejo ingestion-writeback contracts in competitors
refresh_triggers: Before committing to a major workbench or workspace-platform investment
Before selecting a customer deployment edition
After relevant agent protocol or pricing change
